column1: # Python that og dev python-gate allows (docs/rust.md, "No owned Python").
# Every row is third-party Python run inside its own pinned image, named by
# its versions.env variable, or a line that names Python and runs none (a
# check of a log, a stub, an image name). One file per row, never a directory
# or a pattern; a row that covers nothing fails the gate. A Python file is
# owned code and can never be listed here.
# uses is the number of Python uses in the file (each python or package
# runner word, Python heredoc, python #! line and run of the python image
# with no program after it; one line can hold two): a new use is checked
# against the reason before the count changes. marks
# (optional) are texts separated by |; the code of every use line (without
# its comments) must hold one of them, so a use swapped for another at the
